description.value: Rama Farm Market is a locally-owned fruit and vegetable market on Highway 97 in Oliver, BC, at the heart of the Okanagan's agricultural corridor. The market specializes in fresh, locally grown produce sourced directly from their own farms, making it a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists riding through one of Canada's premier fruit-growing regions. The business is active on social media with regular posts showcasing fresh seasonal stock.
